rationale: The agent exhibited a poor tool-use pattern by calling get_files_info at least 8 times with identical arguments, each time receiving the same empty result. It also repeatedly attempted to run non-existent Python scripts via run_python_file (over 10 attempts with different filenames like check_files.py, list_files.py, explore.py, etc.), each failing with the same "outside permitted working directory" error without the agent adjusting its strategy. Most critically, the agent never attempted to write to output.txt or create a script to accomplish the stated task, despite this being the core requirement.
